title: Records
description: Browse the JSON records that tenants store in collections.

collections.title: Collections
collections.emptyBody: Collections appear once records are written through the API.
collections.noList: Listing all collections needs a product role. Enter the name of a collection to open it.

pick.title: Choose a tenant and a collection
pick.body: Records always belong to one tenant. Pick both to browse them.

listDescription: Newest first. Records match when they contain all filters.

filter.label: Filter records
filter.valueHelp: JSON values (true, 42, null) match typed; other text matches as a string.
filter.valueInfo: A record matches when it contains this value. An object value such as {"city": "Graz"} matches records whose field contains these keys; use it to filter nested fields.

descriptionWrite: Browse, create, change and delete the JSON records that tenants store in collections.

write.createDescription: Store a JSON object in a collection of the selected tenant. A new collection name creates the collection.
write.collectionHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
write.collectionInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (at most 63 characters).
write.dataHelp: A JSON object, at most 256 KiB. Saving replaces the whole object.

dataError.object: Record data must be a JSON object.

write.versionNote: Editing version {{version}}. If someone else changed the record in the meantime, saving is refused.
write.deleteBody: Record {{id}} is deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
write.collectionInfo: Collections need no setup: the first record creates one, deleting its last record removes it. A record cannot be moved to another collection later.
write.dataInfo: Saving replaces the whole object: fields you remove are deleted. ID, version and timestamps are set by the server; do not include them.
write.conflictLink: What if someone else changes it?
